title: Football – In-Season
shortDescription: Maintain explosiveness, speed and strength through a demanding season, without compromising match and training load.
description: A season-adapted program built to keep you fast, strong and injury-free throughout the football season. Focus on low-volume/high-quality strength training, reactive speed and mobility that works together with your match and training load.

title: Football – Off-Season
shortDescription: Build the foundation: maximal strength, speed and explosiveness in the period without match pressure.
description: Off-season is where the biggest physical gains happen. This program builds maximal strength, speed, change of direction and jump power, so you start next season stronger and faster than ever.

title: Basketball – In-Season
shortDescription: Keep your vertical and quickness up through a long season with lots of games.
description: A maintenance-focused program for basketball players in-season. Low load, high quality — preserves vertical jump, lateral quickness and strength without stealing recovery from games.

title: Basketball – Off-Season
shortDescription: Build vertical jump, explosiveness and strength before next season.
description: A full off-season plan for basketball players who want to jump higher, move faster and get physically stronger before the season starts.

title: Tennis – In-Season
shortDescription: Maintain rotational power, speed and injury prevention through the tournament season.
description: A program tailored to the tennis player's season calendar. Focus on rotational power, change of direction and shoulder/elbow health, with a training load low enough not to interfere with matches and tournaments.

title: Tennis – Off-Season
shortDescription: Build strength, explosiveness and movement quality before a new season.
description: An off-season program for tennis players who want to build a solid physical foundation: strength, rotational power, lateral speed and robustness through the shoulder and core.

title: Handball – In-Season
shortDescription: Keep throwing power, jump power and speed up through a tough match season.
description: A season program for handball players who want to preserve explosiveness and strength without increasing injury risk during a period with many games and travel.

title: Handball – Off-Season
shortDescription: Build throwing power, jump power and shoulder robustness before a new season.
description: An off-season plan focused on maximal strength, jump power, throwing power and shoulder health — the foundation for an injury-free and explosive season.

title: Ice Hockey – In-Season
shortDescription: Maintain explosiveness and skating power through a long, physical season.
description: A season-adapted program for hockey players. Preserves skating power, explosiveness and strength through a long season with frequent games and travel.

title: Ice Hockey – Off-Season
shortDescription: Build skating power, explosiveness and physical robustness before a new season.
description: An off-season program built to develop skating-specific power, explosiveness and strength, and build physical robustness for a demanding contact sport.

title: Track & Field – In-Season
shortDescription: Fine-tune speed, power and technique toward the competition season.
description: A competition-season program for track & field athletes (sprint/jumps/throws). Focus on peaking form, maintaining power and reducing injury risk between competitions.

title: Track & Field – Off-Season
shortDescription: Build base strength, power and speed heading into a new season.
description: An off-season program for track & field athletes who want to build maximal strength, power development and speed foundation before the competition season starts.

title: Combat Sports – In-Season
shortDescription: Maintain explosiveness and strength through the competition and weight-management period.
description: A season program for combat sports athletes. Preserves explosive power and strength while accounting for weight management and competition scheduling.

title: Combat Sports – Off-Season
shortDescription: Build explosive strength and capacity heading into a new competition period.
description: An off-season plan that builds maximal strength, explosiveness and physical capacity — the foundation for performance when the competition period starts again.

title: Volleyball – In-Season
shortDescription: Keep your vertical jump and arm speed up through a long season of matches and travel.
description: A season-adapted program for volleyball players. Preserves vertical jump, spike/serve power and shoulder health through a demanding match calendar, without adding fatigue that hurts performance on court.

title: Volleyball – Off-Season
shortDescription: Build vertical jump, explosiveness and shoulder resilience before a new season.
description: An off-season plan focused on maximal strength, vertical jump development, arm-speed power and shoulder/knee robustness — the foundation for a strong, injury-free volleyball season.

title: Vertical Jump / Explosiveness
shortDescription: Increase your vertical jump with a structured program for jump height and explosive power development.
description: A dedicated program to increase vertical jump and general explosiveness. Combines plyometrics, strength and technique work in a progressive structure suited for any sport where jump power matters.

title: Speed Program
shortDescription: Get faster with a program built around acceleration, top speed and change of direction.
description: A complete speed program focused on acceleration mechanics, top speed and change of direction (COD). Built on the same principles used with high-level athletes, adapted to your sport.

title: Strength Program
shortDescription: Build base strength and power development with a solid, sport-specific strength program.
description: A progressive strength program built around the major compound lifts and sport-specific variations, focused on power development that transfers directly to the field, the mat, or the court.

title: Strength & Explosiveness – Beginner
shortDescription: A safe, structured entry into strength and explosiveness training for those who are new to it.
description: Built specifically for beginners: proper technique, gradual progression and a well-chosen exercise selection give you a safe foundation in strength and explosiveness, without overwhelming volume or complexity.
